description: Build a DJ-style VJ mixer. Without decks[], it preserves the legacy A/B Cross TOP mixer with GainA/GainB controls. With decks[], it builds a 2-8 deck mixer: every deck pulls a source TOP (or a test source) through gain and FX-send Level TOPs, decks 3+ blend into a running Cross TOP chain, a Switch TOP provides hard transition cuts, a final Cross TOP blends program vs cut, and an additive FX-send bus returns per-deck sends into the master. Output is a Null ready for post-processing or setup_output.

crossfade.description: Master crossfader position: 0 = full deck A, 1 = full deck B, 0.5 = even blend.

cut_deck.description: Zero-based deck index selected by the hard transition-cut bus in N-channel mode.

cut_mix.description: Blend between the continuous program mix and the hard transition-cut bus: 0 = program mix, 1 = cut bus.

deck_a.description: Absolute path of the source TOP for deck A (pulled in via a Select TOP, so it can live in another container). If omitted, a built-in test source (Noise TOP) is created so the mixer builds standalone.

deck_b.description: Absolute path of the source TOP for deck B (pulled in via a Select TOP). If omitted, a built-in test source (Ramp TOP) is created so the mixer builds standalone.

decks.description: Optional N-channel deck list. When supplied, create_decks builds a 2-8 deck mixer with per-deck gain, FX sends, a running blend chain, and a hard-cut switch bus.

fx_send.description: Initial per-deck send amount into the additive FX-send bus.

gain.description: Initial per-deck gain/brightness, exposed as a live control when enabled.

mix.description: For deck 3 and later, the initial blend amount into the running program mix. Decks 1-2 use crossfade.

name.description: Human label for this deck, used in exposed controls and structured output.

source.description: Absolute path of the source TOP for this deck. If omitted, a built-in test source is created.

expose_controls.description: Expose live 'Crossfader' + per-deck 'GainA'/'GainB' knobs on the container so the mix is playable on arrival.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP the mixer container is built inside (default '/project1').

name: create_decks
title: Create DJ-style decks
